subject.research_question: Can any generated mechanism be honestly projected as a test candidate after outcome-field exposure and current readiness checks?

researchability.basis: The run has enough source and governance context to document readiness, but not enough clean outcome-blind state to project any candidate. Several mechanisms are economically plausible, yet each still has explicit machine blockers.
limitations: Outcome fields were printed before freeze; they were discarded but the run is no longer clean for test selection.
Exit lifecycle remains below hard-stop/advisory subtype bars and lacks 5/5/5 touches.
Flow-options lacks 20 settled paired disagreements and has partial options source authorization.
Hawkes news remains below 38 independent settled group-date decisions and 18 dates.
Current portfolio exposure is fail-closed for additions because manual bracket orders are not broker-confirmed.

business_analyst.conclusion: PARK. The mechanisms have coherent business stories, but after outcome-field exposure any test projection would no longer be clean. Transmission from event/flow/advisory observations into an executable portfolio decision is still incomplete.

financial_analyst.conclusion: PARK. Replacement-value accounting is not ready: exit lifecycle needs subtype breadth, flow-options needs settled paired disagreements, and portfolio additions are fail-closed. Cash/no-new-exposure remains the opportunity-cost comparator.

industry_researcher.conclusion: PARK. News/Hawkes and flow/options mechanisms need more independent group/date or paired-decision breadth before industry transmission can be separated from generic beta or peer proximity.

risk_assessor.conclusion: PARK before candidate projection. Outcome-field exposure plus missing touch/source/settlement/portfolio controls blocks D0-D3 admission. Investment Team grants no experimental or trading authority.

conflicts: All roles agree no candidate may be projected this run. Mechanism plausibility is separate from experiment admission.

decision.rationale: The run is contaminated for outcome-blind selection and every plausible path retains concrete machine blockers. Projecting a test candidate would evade the protocol.
decision.next_machine_action: Run authoritative qualify once as no-candidate containment; do not call start or finish. Recheck only when a clean run begins and the relevant reopen/touch/source conditions are met.
